composition_subtypes.role: Compute max path sum via DP with 3x2 states per column

payload.core_composition_summary: Single DP mechanism with 2D state (column index, row and flag) to find optimal path in 3×n grid; no greedy or other family involved.
payload.rationale: The solution solely uses dynamic programming to compute the maximum sum path; there is no coordination with greedy algorithms or multiple distinct mechanisms.
